title: Thomson 43RT1055 FA Series, India, built by SPPL (ro.product.model "SPPL 2K ANDROID TV", product
header:
Thomson 43RT1055 FA Series, India, built by SPPL (ro.product.model "SPPL 2K ANDROID TV", product
SPPL_2K_RT41, device sauve), Realtek RTD2841A (32-bit ARM), Android TV 14 (API 34), build UKRE.260524.055,
fingerprint THOMSON/SPPL_2K_RT41/sauve:14/UKRE.260524.055/16101080:user/release-keys.
1 GB RAM (about 210 MB available on the stock Home), 1080p panel drawn at 1280x720, density 213.

Apply:   TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/disable.sh examples/thomson-43rt1055/debloat.txt
Undo:    TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/restore.sh examples/thomson-43rt1055/debloat.txt
Everything is DISABLED, not uninstalled. Comment out any line you want to keep.

Stock launcher: com.google.android.tvlauncher (plain Android TV, not Google TV; restore.sh and
build-and-install.sh defaults work). The only other HOME claimants are com.realtek.systemservice's and
com.android.tv.settings' FallbackHome; setupwraith is installed but does not claim HOME, so no handover trap.
Live TV app: com.realtek.tv (TvActivity has a leanback entry). HDMI 1-3 and AV come from
com.realtek.tv.passthrough, the tuners from com.realtek.dtv (Cable, Antenna) and com.realtek.tv.atv.
launcher/ config: config.json here (live_tv_package com.realtek.tv, its tile hidden).
Remote: infrared (input device IR_HKIR), no Bluetooth remote bonded. Sideloading works: pm install accepts
a third-party APK that declares HOME.

Applied and checked on a real unit on 2026-10-21, in small batches with a screenshot after each: Live TV,
HDMI and AV still switch, YouTube plays, and with launcher/ installed the real remote's Home, Input,
Settings, app buttons and mic work. A reboot afterwards re-enabled none of the packages below.

Kept on purpose, do not disable:
- com.realtek.tv, com.realtek.tv.passthrough, com.realtek.dtv, com.realtek.dtmb, com.realtek.tv.atv,
com.realtek.tv.isdb, com.realtek.tv.atsc, com.android.providers.tv: Live TV, HDMI, AV and the tuners.
- com.realtek.menu, com.realtek.slices, com.realtek.globalkeyhandler: the source menu and the remote's
Input and Settings keys (on Input, globalkeyhandler opens com.realtek.tv/.SelectInputActivity).
- com.realtek.systemservice, com.realtek.power, com.realtek.energymode, com.realtek.display.monitor.
- com.realtek.connecteddevices: the Bluetooth "Connected devices" settings page.
- com.android.bluetooth, com.google.android.tv.googletvremotepairer (and its customizationsample).
- com.google.android.tv.remote.service: despite the name it holds AtvSearchAssistantService, which the
mic button needs here too (as on tcl-c755-google-tv). Disabled, pressing the mic logged "Unable to start
service ... AtvSearchAssistantService" and nothing happened; re-enabling it brought voice search back.
- Factory packages, never launched: com.hk.factorymenu (HikeenFactory), com.factory.factoryautomation
(HikeenAutoTest).
- com.realtek.mdnsoffload, com.android.tv.mdnsoffloadmanager, com.realtek.media.notification (codec notices).

Already disabled from the factory (stays disabled on restore): com.android.tv (an empty RtkLiveTv stub).

Quirks on this firmware:
- The apex packages below (adservices, ondevicepersonalization, federatedcompute) accepted pm disable-user.
- TvInputManager reports every HDMI port as connected-standby (state 1) with or without a cable, so the
launcher shows no HDMI status; AV reports "No device" correctly.
- launcher/'s Inputs menu switches HDMI and AV, but its Live TV row only reopens com.realtek.tv on the last
input while no channels are scanned: the TV app ignores the tuner's passthrough URI. The stock source
picker (remote's Input key, then Antenna) opens the DVB channel scan instead.
- Network ADB on port 5555 comes back by itself after a reboot while debugging is on: switch debugging off
in Developer options and reboot to close it.

apps.note: Vewd HbbTV/operator-app engine and minidump uploader; India has no HbbTV
